messages:
Mia: Quick accessibility/UX find in the canary row. VoiceOver announces the variant pill and then immediately reads the collapsed row label, so screen reader users hear the allocation twice. Heard: 'Canary 5 percent. Canary 5 percent.' :confused: Sam: Repro on macOS Safari. Looks like we have both an aria-live update on the pill and a live label on the collapsed container. Jia: I couldn't repro with NVDA on Windows; seems VoiceOver-specific. Could be focus order or a hidden label that's not actually hidden to assistive tech. Oliver: Also noticed keyboard users jump focus to the variant pills after expanding, but tab order is inconsistent when the row is collapsed. We should preserve DOM order and use aria-hidden on non-visible duplicates. Aisha: Microcopy: the action next to the pill currently says "Pause rollout". Product intent is to pause the specific variant. Recommend changing to "Pause canary" to avoid confusion. Mia: +1 on "Pause canary". Also, the tooltip copy reads "Pause rollout for this version" which contradicts the button. Need consistency. Jia: Quick implementation idea: remove the duplicate visible label from the collapsed row and keep a single sr-only aria-live element owned by the pill component. Example patch: ``` Canary allocation updated to 5%
Canary 5%
``` Sam: Sounds right. Put the change behind a feature flag and test VoiceOver + NVDA before rolling out. Also add an e2e that asserts only one live region receives updates. Oliver: UX question on the rollback flow: when you scrub the timeline and click rollback, the modal shows "Rolling back to snapshot" but the timestamp displayed is the current time. Looks like we use Date.now() in the modal instead of selectedSnapshot.timestamp. Aisha: That one confused a customer during demo. We should show the snapshot time and also include the version tag: e.g., "Rollback to snapshot v1.4.2 — 2025-07-01 11:20 UTC" Mia: Agree. Also request explicit primary button text: "Rollback to snapshot" (not just "Confirm") and aria-describedby on the warning paragraph: "This will revert traffic and restart variant pods. Historical metrics will be preserved." Jia: I'll own the modal timestamp fix and add a unit test. Will also update the accessible name on the rollback button to include the snapshot id. Sam: I'll open a small PR bundling: 1) de-dupe live region + aria-hidden change, 2) button + tooltip copy switch to "Pause canary", 3) focus ring fix for pills in high contrast. Assigning @Jia to modal time + aria-label for rollback. DesignBot: Accessibility scan scheduled: ADA-AR-2025 (duplicate live region) severity: medium. Pager: design-team. Mia: Can we also add a short checklist in the PR for manual VoiceOver/NVDA test steps? I'll run VoiceOver after the feature-flag is enabled. Sam: Yes, will add QA checklist and mark WIP. ETA PR tomorrow lunchtime. :thumbsup: Jia: Got it, will test and merge once checks pass. Mia: Great catch team, thanks!
__notes: Slack thread about screen reader double announce on canary pill, timeline rollback timestamp bug, copy tweaks for "Pause canary", and proposed code snippet + PR plan. Unique filename and wording.
